definition: to or in a foreign country
description: A sunny market street in a foreign town with arched arcades and fruit stalls under faded awnings. A young red-haired woman with a big backpack, a loose linen shirt, trousers and brown boots stands in the middle holding a hand-drawn map, shading her eyes with one hand and looking lost. Two local men on either side point in opposite directions, one stepping closer as he points. At the end she breaks into a smile. A wheelbarrow and shoppers are behind her and dry hills rise beyond the rooftops.

taps.phrase: to step closer to the traveller
